comparison.objective: Remove spacer dowels so laminate settles and bonds squarely to a drawer front.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential support extraction while controlling sag, tilt, registration, and irreversible contact.
comparison.success_condition: All three laminate panels bond flat within registration tolerances and grippers clear.
comparison.reason: Both involve withdrawing a tool/support without disturbing retained geometry, but laminate settling and irreversible surface bonding are central here; there is no impact fracture or loose-fragment recovery. Specs are absent, but detailed body criteria suffice.
